applies_to: all further ABEP decisions; amends A9.13 owner_statements.xenon and A9.14 OQ-A907-07, XA9Q-07, MPQ-01, XV2Q-01, XA9Q-05, OD6
governing_rule: The official RFP is the sole governing basis for propellant capability. The system shall support both ambient atmospheric propellant (180-230 km) and Xenon propulsion capability. C1-specific Xe requirements, if any, are derived from the selected C1 hardware and integrated into that RFP-compliant Xe architecture; no independent policy shall restrict or override the RFP.
rules: Xe is an RFP-required system capability, not a contingency
C1 is an internal architecture element, not an RFP requirement
a selected C1 that requires Xe has its Xe booked within the system Xe architecture and accounting; a C1 that does not require Xe gets no invented Xe consumption
presence or absence of C1 never removes system Xe capability
two separate propellant tanks/paths: ambient air and Xenon (owner-stated RFP content, pending RFP registration)

amendments.OQ-A907-07: S8.17: flight C1 integration may still be deferred until C1 is selected, but not because Xe is contingency-only
amendments.XA9Q-07: S8.21: YES, Xe capability applies to hall_icp_neutralizer because the RFP requires it
amendments.MPQ-01: S8.33: a selected C1 requiring Xe books its C1-specific branch within the RFP-compliant Xe system; C1 Xe neither assumed nor excluded in advance
amendments.XV2Q-01: S8.35: NOT APPLICABLE, the system is not Xe-free under the RFP
amendments.XA9Q-05: S9.3: an ICP Xe-path getter/filter is an engineering/vendor requirement, not a policy choice
amendments.OD6: S9.10: 'air + Xe' = the system provides both ambient-air and Xenon operating capability; never a contingency interpretation

recorder_notes: this policy concerns system propellant capability; it does not by itself change the A9.1 ICP gas-mode baseline (G-REUSE primary, G-XE declared contingency ICP feed variant), which is a separate ICP-feed choice - flagged to the owner

execution.instruction: apply in the A9.16 decision-application step
execution.merge: no merge to main is authorized by this addendum

immutability: never edited after commit; later owner amendments are new addendum files
